summary: The diff implements both REQ-1 and REQ-2. The worker (vaultGenerator.worker.ts) gains a pure-TypeScript GIF parser, frame extraction, frame-count synchronization, per-frame compositing, and GIF encoding. Vault.tsx gains GIF badge display and ZIP export with correct extensions. ipfsPublishing.ts and metadataPresets.ts gain MIME-type and file-extension handling for GIF vs PNG. All major acceptance criteria appear addressed.
